title: Exchange Program for Graduate Students in Computer Science

requisite_raw: You will need to contact the School of Computing to request a permission code to enrol in this course.
description: Students enrol in this course when they have been approved to participate in a formal Computing exchange with one of the Australian National University's overseas exchange partners. For information regarding Computing exchanges, selection criteria, etc, please go to the following website:Student exchange | ANU College of Engineering, Computing & Cybernetics
